desc: Derive ancestor and joint-ancestor probabilities for random parent sequences.
Derive edge-on-path coefficients for indices relative to query endpoints \(u<v\).
Reduce expected distance to static weighted prefix sums and multiplication by \((N-1)!\).
Implement modular inverse/factorial and the two coefficient prefix sums, answer every query in \(O(1)\).
Validate implementation on all provided samples and boundary cases \(u=1\), adjacent endpoints, and \(N=2\).
